notes: Piece counts match the parts list (219 pieces incl. the sticker sheet). Minifigure parts (hats, heads, torsos, legs, ear defenders) are not in the parts list and are omitted.

Build order: trees/chainsaw/shovel (p4-5), two logs (p6-9, 10 round bricks + 98284 + axle each), truck steps 1-40, crane column (p58-62), crane arm (step 42), grabber (p66-71), wheels (step 44). Cab front sub-assembly (p37-40) is placed before step 25 in id order.

Earlier fixes kept: door grill b148 rests on the roof wedge b145 and is held only by the tile clips b146/b147 (other_joins), because 12825 is a tile with no studs; crane base b173 has rests_on [] because round tile b77 has no studs - it is held on the dark tan axle b59 and only touches b77; logs are joined to the truck bed (loaded in the final picture p74) and the sticker sheet is joined to the tiles that receive stickers.

The 5 groups that remain are real separate items in the booklet, so they are intentionally NOT connected: (1) the truck with crane, grabber, logs, wheels and stickers; (2) pine tree b1 and (3) pine tree b2, which are loose scenery pieces built as single parts (p5) and stand beside the truck in the final picture (p74); (4) the shovel b3, which is only held in a minifigure's hand (p4); (5) the chainsaw b4-b8, built on p5 and held in a minifigure's hands. The minifigures themselves are not in the parts list, so there is nothing in the graph to attach these four accessories to.

Several stacking relations are inferred from small isometric drawings (which plates/bricks a piece bridges); rests_on lists the most plausible supporting pieces. Wheel holders: rear pair b35/b36, middle pair b38/b39, front pair b42/b43.
Bumper sub-assembly (step 12): plate with 2 grille tiles + green 1x2, then a second plate on the green plate's studs carrying the second grille/green set.
Stakes (b167-b170) are held in the LBG clip plates; chains are modelled as joining pairs of stakes.
Side-stud and clip attachments (chainsaw, lights, handles, light covers, grabber clips, claws) are recorded in other_joins with rests_on empty.
